theme_and_archetype.description: Ultra-premium, Linear/Vercel-inspired B2B SaaS design for real estate independent agents. Dominant pure black/gray/white with very subtle, barely-there purple/blue gradient accents.

rules: No solid purple/blue backgrounds or buttons. Accents must be restricted to faint radial blurs (opacity 0.06 - 0.12) or 1px hover borders.
Use radial-gradients for soft 'spotlight' effects behind key sections (like Hero and Pricing).

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]
scales.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: MANDATORY: Delete any usage of 'Instrument Serif'. No more italic serif mixing. The UI must feel like a precision tool.
Headings must exclusively use 'Cabinet Grotesk' with tight tracking to achieve the 'Apple/Linear' structural feel.
Never center paragraphs unless it's a short 1-2 line subtitle under a centered section heading.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Elements must breathe. Avoid Bootstrap-like equal columns; prioritize asymmetry and tension.

mobile_responsive_strategy.under_640px: Stack vertically. CRITICAL: Increase gaps significantly (gap-8 to gap-12). Do NOT render full-height phone mockups here; crop the bottom using mask-image or a max-height container to show only the top UI so it doesn't dominate the screen.
mobile_responsive_strategy.640px_to_900px: Use 2-column bento grids where applicable. Adjust paddings to px-8.
mobile_responsive_strategy.over_900px: Unleash 12-column grids and high-end asymmetrical layouts. Use massive paddings (py-32) between sections.

iphone_mockup_solution.description: Abandon literal phone SVG frames with thick bezels. They look cheap.
css_implementation: Wrap screenshots in a sleek container: `rounded-[40px] border border-white/10 shadow-[0_0_80px_rgba(255,255,255,0.03)] overflow-hidden`.
Apply a subtle 3D tilt on desktop: `transform: perspective(1200px) rotateY(-8deg) rotateX(4deg) scale(0.95)`.

Framer Motion Exploded UI: Add absolutely positioned floating glass cards over the phone. For example, extract the 'Dictée vocale' status into a small pill card `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/20` floating slightly outside the main phone bounds.

framer_motion: Scroll Reveals: Elements should fade up lazily. `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}`.
Floating Elements: The Exploded UI cards should gently float using `animate={{ y: [-5, 5, -5] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 6, ease: 'easeInOut' }}`.
css_interactions: Magnetic Hover: Primary App Store CTAs should slightly scale and follow the cursor if a library is available, or simply use a crisp `hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform`.

Hover Glow Cards: For Bento grid cards, implement a custom CSS glow where a radial gradient follows the mouse, masked by the card bounds. Alternatively, a simple `hover:bg-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300`.

implementation_plan.css_scoping: Ensure all global styles in `/app/frontend/src/pages/marketing/marketing.css` are wrapped under the `.mkt-root` class to prevent pollution into the iOS app.

sections.name: Header
sections.details: Sticky. Glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/5`. Contains nav links, EN/FR/DE/IT switcher, and a small download CTA.

sections.name: Hero Landing
sections.details: Asymmetrical layout. Left: Massive H1, tight body text, premium App Store CTA. Right: The 3D tilted phone mockup of `live_home_john.jpeg` with floating UI pills. Background features the `--mkt-accent-glow` spotlight.

sections.name: Trusted By Marquee
sections.details: Infinite smooth scrolling marquee. 15 real estate network logos (use Lucide icons or simple text SVGs as placeholders). Opacity 40%, pure white on hover.

sections.name: Promise Section
sections.details: Bento Grid of 3 cards (Pige IA, Dictée vocale, Suivi dossiers). Dark glassmorphism (`bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.08]`). Incorporate Lucide icons with a faint purple/blue drop-shadow.

sections.name: Stats Section
sections.details: Minimalist grid displaying massive numbers: '30sec', '0 oubli', '1 app'. Text color pure white. Add a thin vertical 1px divider (`border-l border-white/10`) between stats on desktop.

sections.name: Steps Section (How Kolo)
sections.details: Sticky scrolling track. Left column stays fixed explaining 'Pige' then 'Dictée vocale'. Right column scrolls the corresponding screenshots (`live_pige.jpeg`, `live_dossiers.jpeg`) wrapped in premium Abstract Frames.

sections.name: Quote Section
sections.details: Centered. Large typography `text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-medium tracking-tight`. Text wrapped in quotes, with a floating avatar and agent name below.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.details: One single centered premium card (24,90€/mois). Features an animated gradient border (using the barely-there purple/blue hexes via a spinning mask-image pseudo-element) to scream 'pro tool'. List 7 features.

sections.name: Footer
sections.details: Deep dark gray `bg-[#050505]`. Huge 'KOLO' logo at the bottom. Product/Company/Legal links.

implementation_plan.other_pages: Apply the same typography, spacing, and glassmorphic card patterns to `/comment-kolo`, `/ressources`, `/a-propos`, and `/legal`.
